module.purpose: Provides node, parent, handle, connection, viewport, and dimension bookkeeping utilities for the graph store.
module.summary: This module maintains internal node representations derived from user nodes, including absolute positions, dimensions, handle bounds, selection z-order, parent relationships, and expansion behavior. It also updates DOM-measured internals, constrains viewport panning, and builds indexed connection and edge lookups. The implementation mutates lookup maps, preserves unchanged internal nodes when equality checks succeed, and coordinates parent-child geometry and z-index rules.
module.businessContext: Supports an interactive node-based graph editor. If these calculations fail, nodes can render at incorrect positions, parent containers can size incorrectly, and connections or viewport movement can become inconsistent.
